# Rogue (`classes:rogue`)
**Hit Die:** d8 | **Saving Throws:** [DEX](../ability-scores/dex.md), [INT](../ability-scores/int.md)
**Primary Ability:** [DEX](../ability-scores/dex.md)
**Subclasses:** [Thief](../subclasses/thief.md)
**Proficiencies:** [Light Armor](../proficiencies/light-armor.md), [Simple Weapons](../proficiencies/simple-weapons.md), [Rapiers](../proficiencies/rapiers.md), [Scimitars](../proficiencies/scimitars.md), [Shortswords](../proficiencies/shortswords.md), [Whips](../proficiencies/whips.md), [Hand crossbows](../proficiencies/hand-crossbows.md), [Tool: Thieves' Tools](../proficiencies/tool-thieves-tools.md), [Saving Throw: DEX](../proficiencies/saving-throw-dex.md), [Saving Throw: INT](../proficiencies/saving-throw-int.md)

## Proficiency Choices
- Choose 4: Acrobatics, Athletics, Deception, Insight, Intimidation, Investigation, Perception, Persuasion, Sleight of Hand, or Stealth ([Skill: Acrobatics](../proficiencies/skill-acrobatics.md), [Skill: Athletics](../proficiencies/skill-athletics.md), [Skill: Deception](../proficiencies/skill-deception.md), [Skill: Insight](../proficiencies/skill-insight.md), [Skill: Intimidation](../proficiencies/skill-intimidation.md), [Skill: Investigation](../proficiencies/skill-investigation.md), [Skill: Perception](../proficiencies/skill-perception.md), [Skill: Persuasion](../proficiencies/skill-persuasion.md), [Skill: Sleight of Hand](../proficiencies/skill-sleight-of-hand.md), [Skill: Stealth](../proficiencies/skill-stealth.md))

## Starting Equipment
- (a) Leather Armor, 2 Daggers, Shortsword, Shortbow, 20 Arrows, Quiver, Thieves’ Tools, Burglar’s Pack, and 8 GP; (b) 100 GP ([Leather Armor](../equipment/leather-armor.md), [Dagger](../equipment/dagger.md), [Shortsword](../equipment/shortsword.md), [Shortbow](../equipment/shortbow.md), [Arrows](../equipment/arrows.md), [Quiver](../equipment/quiver.md), [Thieves' Tools](../equipment/thieves-tools.md), [Burglar's Pack](../equipment/burglars-pack.md))

## Multiclassing
- Prerequisites: [DEX](../ability-scores/dex.md) 13+
- Proficiencies: [Light Armor](../proficiencies/light-armor.md), [Tool: Thieves' Tools](../proficiencies/tool-thieves-tools.md)
- Choice: Choose 1: [Skill: Acrobatics](../proficiencies/skill-acrobatics.md), [Skill: Athletics](../proficiencies/skill-athletics.md), [Skill: Deception](../proficiencies/skill-deception.md), [Skill: Insight](../proficiencies/skill-insight.md), [Skill: Intimidation](../proficiencies/skill-intimidation.md), [Skill: Investigation](../proficiencies/skill-investigation.md), [Skill: Perception](../proficiencies/skill-perception.md), [Skill: Persuasion](../proficiencies/skill-persuasion.md), [Skill: Sleight of Hand](../proficiencies/skill-sleight-of-hand.md), [Skill: Stealth](../proficiencies/skill-stealth.md)
